tips: | Probably the only "pure" hard counter to Maokai Support. He basically neutralizes you in every phase of the game. In lane with his tankiness, sustain and counter-engage. And later stages of the game with his ultimate. The only reason why he isn't a must ban, is because it is a very unpopular pick.

| Moving up her to highest tier on 14.1. | While I consider her one of the more volatile/feast or famine ADC-s, she is pretty hard to deal with as Maokai. Her dash bypasses your W (since it's a root, which she can buffer) and her burst is very high. If she is paired with an Engage support like Alistar or Rell, they can 100-0 your ADC pretty reliably without you being able to peel. Currently my personal perma-ban.

| While I consider him an easy/even matchup in an isolated 2v2, his mobility/slipperiness with his E actually does make it somewhat difficult to kill, assuming they play correctly, especially that they run Guardian most of the times. Decent ban candidate.

| Vayne is pretty difficult to deal with. Despite being a hyper-carry, she spikes hard on lvl6, and she can pretty much run you down after 1st item, especially with Ghost. Probably has one of the highest solo-carry potential when it comes to SoloQ environment, and she is also pretty hard to itemise against because of her %HP true dmg. Until Riot nerfs her or Triforce, she is probably a good consideration for a ban.

| Draven is a strong lane-bully, that can be difficult to deal with at early stage. Most ADC's can't match his dmg in lane so you can't really do much vs him and his support either. If your all in doesn't burst him 100-0, then you are just risking feeding him. You definitely need both Q+W and ignite to really consider engaging against him.
| Similar to Samira but less popular, and her teamfighting is overall weaker as well. Still a champion that can be difficult to deal with depending on the 2v2 matchup.

| Moving her down a tier on 14.1, because I consider her pretty weak currently. Early lvls (1-2) are still difficult vs her, but at lvl 3 you have killpressure on her and her (usually) squishy support.

| Sivir isn't really a threat until she gets a few items, but she does neutralize lane against you most of the time if she uses her E properly. In this matchup you probably wanna focus heavily on roaming, because it's very hard to all in her if she plays safely.

| Similarly to Sivir, she can be hard to 100-0 because of her self-peel, while having better playmaking thanks to her E (Bladecaller) abilty. Luckily her R at early stages has a very long CD, so she is reasonably manageable.
| While his early game was nerfed recently, dealing with his turrets in lane is still somewhat problematic for Maokai. Overall easier to punish than before though, so moving him down a tier.

| In theory Milio should be a bigger counter to Maokai because of his utility and ultimate, but the champion in general doesn't do that well vs heavy dive even with his ult's CC cleansing effect. That being said, in certain 2v2 matchups the early trading power his passive provides for his ADC can be very strong. and can turn them into a bit of a raid boss as the game goes on.

| The matchup isn't bad for Maokai, but she does have a stronger early game IMO both in lane, and with roams/early skirmishes. You outscale her though, and have superior objective control as well in the later stages of the game.

| Matchup depends a lot on the ADC picks, but he spikes harder than you on lvl 2 even with W+Q/Q+W start, and his lvl 6 is insanely strong. | You do outscale him as the game goes on, similarly to Rell.

| Support Twitch specifically. While I don't think the champion is strong as a support, it still takes a lot of effort from your entire team to play around this cheese pick. You need to be on top of your ping/vision game, and your team needs to respect his lvl 1 Shenanigans and roams.
